title: Project Intelligence
description: A persistent, machine-readable model of what a host repository is, produced by Discovery and consumed by every subsequent task (ADR-0015). Written to .aiecp/project-intelligence.json in the host repo. This replaces re-deriving 'what is this repository' from scratch on every task.

generated_by.description: Which discovery detector pipeline version produced this.

stale.description: Set true by the discovery-refresh trigger when repository structure has changed since generated_at. Consumers MUST re-run discovery before trusting a stale=true document.

capabilities.description: What discovery confirmed the project actually supports/uses, as opposed to what the framework hopes it supports.

external_integrations.description: Third-party services/APIs detected in config/dependencies, e.g. ['stripe', 'auth0'].

conventions.description: Detected or declared coding conventions. Populated best-effort; empty is valid.

source.description: Where this constraint was detected or declared.

dependencies.description: Top-level dependency manifest summary (not a full lockfile mirror).

environments.description: Named environments the project supports, e.g. ['local', 'ci', 'staging', 'production'] — used to scope safety gates (docs/security-model.md).
